# Provenance

All research quantities in the rendered pages are copied from the pinned files below or computed as counts, sums and range endpoints from those files. Sequence identifiers are source labels. Technical metadata dimensions, schema versions, URLs, hashes and licence versions come from the worker brief or the file formats, not research measurements.

The total new-term count is the sum of `new_count` in `oeis/data/verification.json`. The initial 48 BB6 lemmas and 198 rejected corruptions are sums across the stage2b local verification files. The additional 118 rules, 470 rejected corruptions and 3973 concrete instantiations are sums across the certificates in bb6/data/stage2c/local-verification.json and match its final summary. The six-hour duration is the recorded 21600.08631 seconds in time-discipline.json; it is a rounded description, not a fresh timing measurement. Batch C scores, minimum distance and active wall seconds come from its REPORT.txt and exact construction files. New starting indices equal `listed_last + 1`. Timing decimals are copied exactly from the source verification manifest. The social image uses the same results table as the home page.

## Limitations and attribution

Batch C and BB6 stage 2c are included from their final committed snapshots. The hm-batchC sources/ directory contains third-party research material and is excluded in full; upstream references remain links in its first-party report. Source reports are historical records; their descriptions of commits or posts apply to the source worker run. OEIS definitions are attributed quotations. Published baseline constructions retain the source attribution documented in the campaign reports. No third-party implementation is copied into this repository. Sprint management rules are drawn from the parent sprint README; private and unrelated project information is intentionally excluded.
